author: TREY the Explainer
description:
Hello! 
I watched Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey and decided to record my initial thoughts and musings on the film and its connection to Homer's poem. It's a bit rambling but I hope you find some of it interesting nonetheless. Your support for this channel is greatly appreciated!

My patreon: https://patreon.com/TreytheExplainer?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink

title: My Thoughts on Nolan's The Odyssey
